x: Especially in the case of Rispin, who ran strongly all the way to finish in the first dozen. Owing to some "A" men not turning out, Footer had more than his share of men to take along.
Several of our younger members gave sterling accounts of themselves : Beard, Rispin, Shrubb and others, who will prove their worth in later races.

Boyden, Smith and Rispin 84—86, while Mitchell at 112 was just two places ahead of Tommy Morrell. The course on the big lap was hilly, rather sandy, and loose in places, but quite dry, and the leaders began to go away from the rest of the field.
